summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Phase 5: Categories & Subcategories. All 19 backend API tests pass (100%). All frontend features tested and working: Menu page category navigation with images, subcategory dropdown/pills, category landing pages with hero images, admin category management with drag-reorder, visibility toggles, and CRUD operations.
critical_code_review_comments: All frontend API calls correctly use relative URLs (/api/...) to avoid CORS issues
Category navigation bar shows images for each category with proper highlighting on selection
Subcategory dropdown appears on category click, subcategory pills bar shows when category is selected
Category landing pages (/menu/:slug) show hero image, description, subcategory bar, and filtered items
Admin sidebar correctly includes 'Categories' link between Catalog and Orders
Admin category table shows drag handles, images, names, slugs, descriptions, subcategory count badges, visibility toggles, edit/delete buttons
Admin visibility toggle works via PATCH /api/admin/categories/:id/toggle
Admin Add/Edit Category form has all required fields: name, slug, description, image URL, parent selector, visibility toggle
Creating subcategory with parent selector works correctly
Backend properly seeds 4 top-level categories (Starters, Mains, Drinks, Desserts) with 12 subcategories
seed_data_creation: 16 categories seeded on startup: 4 top-level (Starters, Mains, Drinks, Desserts) + 12 subcategories (Soups, Salads, Small Plates, Meat, Seafood, Vegetarian, Red Wine, White Wine, Sparkling, Non-Alcoholic, Pastries, Chocolate)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 5 categories fully tested. All features working: (1) Menu page at /menu shows category navigation bar with images (All, Starters, Mains, Drinks, Desserts), (2) Clicking category filters items and shows subcategory dropdown, (3) Subcategory pills bar appears below category nav when category selected, (4) Category landing pages at /menu/:slug show hero image, description, subcategory bar, filtered items grid, (5) Admin at /admin/categories shows 4 top-level + 12 subcategories with drag handles, visibility toggles, edit/delete, (6) Admin Add Category form at /admin/categories/new has name, slug, description, image URL, parent selector, visibility toggle, (7) Creating subcategory with parent works, (8) Visibility toggle works via API. Apple and Facebook social login buttons remain MOCKED (visual placeholders only).
